run_gpu_exact_search_benchmark: run a FAISS GPU exact search benchmark on SIFT1M using GpuIndexFlatL2 with varying k values
run_gpu_approximate_search_benchmark: run a FAISS GPU approximate search benchmark on SIFT1M using IVF4096 PQ64 with varying nprobe values
create_gpu_flat_index: create a FAISS GpuIndexFlatL2 index with GpuIndexFlatConfig for exact L2 nearest neighbor search on GPU
clone_cpu_index_to_gpu: clone a FAISS CPU index to GPU using GpuClonerOptions with float16 lookup tables for PQ indices
benchmark_ivf_pq_with_nprobe: benchmark an IVF4096 PQ64 GPU index by varying nprobe and measuring recall at 1, 10, and 100
